skill.summary: Amazon Checkout - Use the new UCP search function from Shop App from Shopify.

latestVersion.changelog:
**Major upgrade with new payment rails, multi-merchant support, and improved platform structure.**

- Expanded from Amazon-only to multi-merchant checkout: now supports Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce, Squarespace, BigCommerce, Wix, and others, each with individual guides.
- Introduced modular skill files for various platforms, management, storefronts, Stripe wallet, and agent submodules.
- Replaced single "Card Wallet" rail with distinct "My Card" and "Stripe Wallet (x402)" rails; updated all payment/approval and security documentation.
- Enhanced security controls with ephemeral card sessions, one-time decryption keys, and automatic sub-agent deletion for sensitive operations.
- New user onboarding flow and broader owner controls, with polling/status APIs and vendor discovery guides.
- Cleaned up and reorganized documentation for easier navigation and separation by functionality.
